stem: Which of the following describes an experiment rather than an observational study?
choices: Researchers randomly assign 50 plants to receive fertilizer or no fertilizer, then measure their growth.
Researchers record how many hours students sleep and compare their grades.
Researchers survey shoppers about how often they buy organic food.
Researchers count birds at a lake each month for a year.
steps: In an experiment, researchers impose a treatment on the subjects.
In an observational study, researchers only measure what already happens.
Only the first choice assigns a treatment (fertilizer), and it does so randomly.
key: Experiment = researchers assign the treatment. Observational = researchers just observe.
